transition_policy.between_states: Finish exit to the exact common N, then enter the next state.
transition_policy.loop_exit: Queue exit until the sustain anchor is reached.
transition_policy.one_shot_exit: Complete forward one-shot sustain, then play the separate recovery exit.
transition_policy.duplicate_anchor_timing: First and last loop anchor durations are split; their sum equals one anchor exposure.

sustain_contract: Enter N to settled S once; sustain stays in state for every frame; exit S to N once.

gaze_family.name: 16方向注视
gaze_family.midpoint_reuse: The mild head/eye movement is physically reversible; entry midpoint is reused for exit.
